# James R. McCarthy (Jim McCarthy)

> AI is a differentiator in operations, in the business, and in the technology.

James R. McCarthy (Jim McCarthy): I have the privilege of leading Case FMS, a leading provider of exterior facility maintenance across the United States and Canada, with more than 35,000 client locations. AI is a differentiator in operations, in the business, and in the technology. He writes about the operating work, the tools, golf with his son, care at home, and leadership.

## Canonical identity

- Name: James R. McCarthy
- Goes by: Jim McCarthy
- Role: President of Case FMS. I have the privilege of leading Case FMS, a leading provider of exterior facility maintenance across the United States and Canada, with more than 35,000 client locations. AI is a differentiator in operations, in the business, and in the technology.
- Prior role: Chief Operating Officer, Vixxo (2019–2026)
